title: extract summarize run 결과 (v0)
description: 요구사항 추출 extract의 summarize run이 내는 결과 제안(requirements-extraction-flow.md 16.4, 결정 15, AI 결정 113). 앱이 렌더링한 통계와 목록만 읽고 {글, 전역 ID} 서술, handoff 요약, risks를 낸다. extraction.md와 handoff.md는 앱이 렌더링한다(결정 15). 필드 설명은 영어로 쓴다(16.2, D98).

overview.description: Paragraphs for the overview at the top of the result document: what was analyzed, what was found, and what remains open. Each paragraph lists the global IDs it speaks about.

handoff_summary.description: Two or three sentences for the next step, which reviews the result.

risks.description: What the next step should watch: open unknowns, conflicts, held or failed units, lowered or unreviewed claims, perspectives nothing reached, a partial analysis.

gid.description: A global ID from the packet or the record listing: c-NNNN claim, u-NNNN unit, h-NNNN human decision. Never a local key.

ids.description: Global IDs from the packet that this text speaks about.
